causal_hypotheses.title: Wedding Season Inventory Crisis
causal_hypotheses.observation: Kurti Set & Bridal Lehenga OOS during peak wedding season (Nov); Women's Fashion grew +22% but Priya's revenue fell 34.4%. Direct OOS revenue loss: ₹99,610.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Restoring Kurti Set (180→100 unit buffer) and Lehenga (42→30 unit buffer) captures the wedding/gifting surge.
causal_hypotheses.action: Emergency restock Kurti Set & Lehenga from Mumbai textile suppliers; pause ads on 8 OOS SKUs immediately.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: If supplier lead time >7 days, source from Surat wholesale market.

causal_hypotheses.title: Size Chart & Listing Quality Improvement
causal_hypotheses.observation: 32% of cancellations (11 orders) are size mismatches. Embroidered Saree listing score only 44 — missing size guide, fit chart, and care instructions.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Adding size charts and 'fits true to size' photos reduces size-related returns from 12% to <5%.
causal_hypotheses.action: Upload detailed size charts, measurement guide, and 5+ product images for Saree and Kurti listings.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: Track 2-week return rate after update; revert to previous images if returns rise.

causal_hypotheses.title: Wedding Season Festive Deal Enrollment
causal_hypotheses.observation: Women's Fashion grew +22% in November (wedding + Diwali gifting). Priya not enrolled in festive deals despite Gold Seller status.
causal_hypotheses.mechanism: Enrolling in-stock Palazzo Pants and Cotton Tops in Festive Deals captures +40% organic impressions during peak season.
causal_hypotheses.action: Enroll Palazzo Pants, Cotton Tops, and active Saree listings in Snapdeal November Festive Deals today.
causal_hypotheses.stop_condition: Restrict enrollment to SKUs with >50 units stock.

playbook.title: Wedding Season Out-of-Stock Recovery
playbook.text: Emergency restock Kurti Set and Bridal Lehenga within 48 hours from Mumbai textile suppliers or Surat wholesale market. Pause ads on all 8 OOS listings immediately to prevent post-order cancellations. Maintain 100-unit buffer for Kurti Set and 30-unit buffer for Lehenga during peak wedding season (Nov-Feb).

playbook.title: Size Mismatch & Return Rate Reduction
playbook.text: 32% of cancellations are size-related. Upload detailed size charts with measurements in cm and inches, model height/weight for reference photos, and care washing instructions. Adding 'fits true to size' verified badges reduces return rate from 12% to below 5%.

playbook.title: Fashion Listing Quality & Search Visibility
playbook.text: Embroidered Saree listing score is only 44 — well below the 75+ threshold for search boosting. Upload 6+ lifestyle images, add colour/fabric/occasion keywords in bullet points, and complete the size guide. Listings above 75 score get 2x more organic search impressions on Snapdeal.

playbook.title: Wedding & Festive Season Deal Campaign
playbook.text: Women's Fashion grew 22% in November. Enroll Palazzo Pants, Cotton Tops, and active Saree listings in Snapdeal Festive Deals to capture +40% organic impressions. Gold Seller status guarantees banner placement in category pages during the festive window.

playbook.title: Fashion Pricing & Competitor Benchmarking
playbook.text: Kurti Set priced ₹749 vs market ₹649 (15% premium) during peak demand. Matching market price at ₹649 retains ₹234 net profit (36% margin) while rebounding conversion. Embroidered Saree at ₹1,299 vs ₹1,199 market — dropping to ₹1,199 retains ₹384 net margin (32%).
